title: unless / in case / as long as / provided that

items.q: You won't be able to access the server ___ you enter the correct password.
items.e: unless = if not: a menos que ingreses la contraseña.

items.q: Take a copy of the configuration file ___ something goes wrong during the update.
items.e: Preparación anticipada → in case (por si acaso).

items.q: The application will work correctly ___ all the dependencies are installed.
The software won't work properly ___ you update the operating system.
We can finish the project on time ___ everyone meets their deadlines.
items.e: as long as = siempre y cuando.

items.q: Save your work regularly ___ your computer crashes.
items.e: Por si acaso se cuelga la computadora.

items.q: I'll help you ___ that you pay me back.
I'll take an umbrella ___ it rains.
___ the tests pass, we won't deploy.
items.e: Unless the tests pass = if the tests don't pass.

items.q: I'll visit you ___ I have time. (quizás sí, quizás no)

title: unless / in case / provided that + verbo
instructions: Completá con la forma correcta del verbo entre paréntesis. Ninguna de estas conjunciones lleva will.
text:
1. I'll take some food in case we [1] (get) hungry.
2. She won't enjoy her new school unless she [2] (make) friends.
3. I'll help you provided that you [3] (pay) me back.
4. Unless the tests [4] (pass), we won't deploy.
5. I'll create a backup in case something [5] (go) wrong.
6. We took some water in case we [6] (get) thirsty.
7. You can wait here as long as you [7] (not / mind) being on your own.

items.e: in case + Present Simple, no will.
unless ya es negativo: no dupliques la negación.
Unless the tests pass (= if the tests don't pass).
Tu apunte: in case something goes wrong.
En el pasado: in case + Past Simple.
as long as + Present Simple (negativo: don't mind).

title: ¿Cuál oración es correcta? (unless / in case / provided that)

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: Unless she doesn't come, we'll start.
Unless she not comes, we'll start.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: I'll take food in case I will be hungry.
I'll take food in case I am hungry.
I'll take food in case I would be hungry.
items.a: I'll take food in case I am hungry.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: I'll help provided that you will pay.
I'll help provided that you pay.
items.a: I'll help provided that you pay.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: I'll take an umbrella in case it will rain.
I'll take an umbrella in case it rains.
I'll take an umbrella in case it rain.
items.a: I'll take an umbrella in case it rains.
items.e: Tu apunte: ❌ in case it will rain → ✔ in case it rains.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: You can wait here as long as you don't mind being alone.
You can wait here as long as you won't mind being alone.
You can wait here as long as you not mind being alone.
items.a: You can wait here as long as you don't mind being alone.

title: I wish / If only
instructions: Elegí la opción correcta. ¿Presente, habilidad, queja sobre otro o arrepentimiento del pasado?

items.q: I wish I ___ how to fix this bug without asking for help.
items.e: Presente que no nos gusta → Past Simple.

know: después de wish se retrocede un tiempo: wish + pasado simple (knew) para el presente.
had known: had known es arrepentimiento del PASADO. Acá hablás del presente (how to fix this bug): knew.
would know: wish + would es para quejas o cambios en otros; know es un estado y no usa would.

items.q: If only we ___ the code before deploying it!

tested: pasado simple habla del presente. before deploying es una acción pasada: arrepentimiento → had tested.
would test: wish/if only + would es para quejas o cambios futuros; acá es un arrepentimiento del pasado: had tested.
have tested: si es pasado, se usa past perfect (had tested), no have tested.

items.q: I wish I ___ code as fast as her.

can: después de wish se retrocede un tiempo: can → could.
would: would no expresa habilidad; para habilidad que no tenés: could.
will: después de wish no se usa will; para habilidad: could.

items.q: My colleague keeps interrupting me. I wish he ___ interrupting my meetings.

stops: wish + presente simple no se usa; para pedir que alguien cambie su conducta: would stop.
has stopped: wish + presente perfecto no se usa; el cambio deseado: would stop.
stopping: stopping solo no es un verbo conjugado; para pedir que pare: would stop.

items.q: I wish we ___ the farm. It's been such hard work.
items.e: Tu apunte: I wish we hadn't bought the farm.

didn't buy: pasado simple habla del presente. Es un arrepentimiento del pasado: hadn't bought.
wouldn't buy: wouldn't es para quejas o cambios futuros; acá es un arrepentimiento del pasado: hadn't bought.
haven't bought: para un arrepentimiento del pasado hace falta past perfect: hadn't bought.

items.q: If only I ___ more free time to code side projects.

have: después de wish/if only se retrocede un tiempo: have → had.
would have: would no se usa con have (tener, un estado); después de if only se retrocede un tiempo: had.
had had: had had sería arrepentimiento del pasado. Acá hablás del presente: had.

items.q: I wish I ___ more before the exam yesterday.

studied: pasado simple habla del presente. yesterday es pasado: arrepentimiento → had studied.
would study: wish + would es para quejas o cambios futuros; acá es un arrepentimiento del pasado: had studied.
study: después de wish no se usa presente; arrepentimiento del pasado: had studied.

items.q: I wish I ___ more people here.
items.e: Deseo sobre uno mismo → Past Simple, no would.

know: después de wish se retrocede un tiempo: wish + pasado simple (knew).
would know: wish + would es para quejas o cambios en otros; know es un estado y no usa would.
had known: had known sería arrepentimiento del pasado. Acá hablás del presente: knew.

items.q: If only I ___ sing!

can: después de if only se retrocede un tiempo: can → could.
would: would no expresa habilidad; para habilidad que no tenés: could.
will: después de if only no se usa will; para habilidad: could.

items.q: I wish the client ___ respond faster to emails.
items.e: Queja sobre otra persona → would + base.

will: después de wish no se usa will; para pedir un cambio en otra persona: would.
had: wish the client had + respond no existe; para pedir un cambio: would respond.
did: wish the client did + respond no existe; para pedir un cambio: would respond.

title: I wish / If only: escribí la forma
instructions: Completá con la forma correcta del verbo entre paréntesis.
text:
1. I wish I [1] (know) more about cybersecurity.
2. If only our team [2] (have) more time to improve the user interface.
3. I wish I [3] (not / forget) to commit my changes yesterday.
4. If only we [4] (test) the application before releasing it.
5. My neighbours are so annoying! I wish they [5] (stop) yelling all the time.
6. If only I [6] (can) fix this bug.
7. I wish we [7] (live) nearer the city centre.
8. I wish I [8] (not / buy) this laptop. It's too slow.

pat: después de wish se retrocede un tiempo: wish + pasado simple (knew).
wish + would es para quejas o cambios en otros; know es un estado: knew.
had known es arrepentimiento del pasado; acá hablás del presente: knew.
después de if only se retrocede un tiempo: have → had (had more time).
had had sería arrepentimiento del pasado; acá hablás del presente: had.
yesterday es pasado: arrepentimiento del pasado → past perfect (hadn't forgotten).
el participio de forget es forgotten (forget → forgot → forgotten): hadn't forgotten.
before releasing es una acción pasada: arrepentimiento → past perfect (had tested).
wouldn't stop significa que no quieren parar; queremos que paren: would stop.
para pedir que alguien cambie su conducta (quejas) se usa would + verbo base: would stop.
items.e: Queja sobre otros: would + verbo base. (Antes respondiste 'wouldn't' sin el verbo.)

pat: after if only se retrocede un tiempo: can → could.
después de wish se retrocede un tiempo: wish + pasado simple (lived).
arrepentimiento del pasado (ya compraste): past perfect (hadn't bought).
el participio de buy es bought (buy → bought → bought): hadn't bought.

title: ¿Para qué se usa? (I wish / If only)
instructions: Elegí la función de la parte en negrita.

items.q: I wish we **lived** nearer the city centre.
items.e: Vivimos lejos y no nos gusta.

Habilidad: wish/if only + could = habilidad que no tenemos. Acá tenés lived (pasado simple).
Queja sobre otra persona: wish/if only + would = queja o cambio que queremos en otra persona. Acá tenés lived (pasado simple).
Arrepentimiento del pasado: wish/if only + past perfect (had + participio) = arrepentimiento del pasado. Acá tenés lived (pasado simple).

items.q: If only I **could sing**.

Presente que no nos gusta: wish + pasado simple (lived, had) = algo del presente que no nos gusta. Acá tenés could sing.
Queja sobre otra persona: wish/if only + would = queja o cambio que queremos en otra persona. Acá tenés could sing.
Arrepentimiento del pasado: wish/if only + past perfect (had + participio) = arrepentimiento del pasado. Acá tenés could sing.

items.q: If only they **wouldn't make** so much noise.

Presente que no nos gusta: wish + pasado simple (lived, had) = algo del presente que no nos gusta. Acá tenés wouldn't make (would).
Habilidad: wish/if only + could = habilidad que no tenemos. Acá tenés wouldn't make (would).
Arrepentimiento del pasado: wish/if only + past perfect (had + participio) = arrepentimiento del pasado. Acá tenés wouldn't make (would).

items.q: I wish we **hadn't bought** the farm.

Presente que no nos gusta: wish + pasado simple (lived, had) = algo del presente que no nos gusta. Acá tenés hadn't bought (past perfect).
Habilidad: wish/if only + could = habilidad que no tenemos. Acá tenés hadn't bought (past perfect).
Queja sobre otra persona: wish/if only + would = queja o cambio que queremos en otra persona. Acá tenés hadn't bought (past perfect).

items.q: I wish my colleague **would stop** interrupting my meetings.

Presente que no nos gusta: wish + pasado simple (lived, had) = algo del presente que no nos gusta. Acá tenés would stop (would).
Habilidad: wish/if only + could = habilidad que no tenemos. Acá tenés would stop (would).
Arrepentimiento del pasado: wish/if only + past perfect (had + participio) = arrepentimiento del pasado. Acá tenés would stop (would).

items.q: I wish I **had** more free time.

Habilidad: wish/if only + could = habilidad que no tenemos. Acá tenés had (pasado simple).
Queja sobre otra persona: wish/if only + would = queja o cambio que queremos en otra persona. Acá tenés had (pasado simple).
Arrepentimiento del pasado: wish/if only + past perfect (had + participio) = arrepentimiento del pasado. Acá tenés had (pasado simple).

items.q: If only I **had studied** more before the exam.

Presente que no nos gusta: wish + pasado simple (lived, had) = algo del presente que no nos gusta. Acá tenés had studied (past perfect).
Habilidad: wish/if only + could = habilidad que no tenemos. Acá tenés had studied (past perfect).
Queja sobre otra persona: wish/if only + would = queja o cambio que queremos en otra persona. Acá tenés had studied (past perfect).

title: ¿Cuál oración es correcta? (I wish / If only)

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: I wish I would know more people.
I wish I knew more people.
I wish I know more people.
items.a: I wish I knew more people.
items.e: Deseo sobre uno mismo → Past Simple, no would.

know es un estado y no se usa con would; wish + pasado simple: knew.
después de wish se retrocede un tiempo: wish + pasado simple (knew).

items.q: Elegí la correcta:

después de if only se retrocede un tiempo: can → could.
will no se usa después de if only; habilidad: could.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: I wish we didn't buy the farm.
I wish we hadn't bought the farm.
I wish we hadn't buy the farm.
items.a: I wish we hadn't bought the farm.

pasado simple habla del presente. Arrepentimiento del pasado → past perfect: hadn't bought.
después de hadn't va el participio: bought.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: I wish they wouldn't made noise.
I wish they wouldn't make noise.
I wish they wouldn't making noise.
items.a: I wish they wouldn't make noise.

después de wouldn't va el verbo base: make.
después de wouldn't va el verbo base: make.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: I wish I would study more.

wish + would es para quejas o cambios en otros; de uno mismo se usa wish + pasado simple: studied.
después de wish se retrocede un tiempo: wish + pasado simple (studied).

items.q: The deployment failed ___ a missing environment variable.
I slept very late last night. ___, I missed the morning shift.
She was late ___ it was raining heavily.
items.e: because + oración (sujeto + verbo); due to + sustantivo.

items.q: ___, run the tests. Then, build the project. Finally, deploy to production.
___, I think static typing prevents a lot of bugs.
___ she loves ice cream so much, I decided to give her an ice-cream printed dress.
The match got cancelled ___ the heavy rain.
___, it is always better to take prevention.
I got stuck in the traffic. ___, I missed the flight.
___, I don't support the idea.

title: Conectores: completá
text:
1. The build failed [1] a missing dependency.
2. I disagree [2] the idea of buying a new server.
3. [3], let's review the requirements. [4], we design the solution. [5], we deploy.
4. The server crashed. [6], the team had to roll back the release.
5. [7] my point of view, the project is terrific.

items.e: Sustantivo (a missing dependency) → due to / because of.
